fcf_source: FY2025 owner earnings: OCF PLN 2,697.4m less D&A PLN 505.0m = PLN 2,192.4m / 980.4m shares = PLN 2.24/sh (Dino-Polska-Group-2025-Consolidated-Financial-Statements.pdf). Growth CapEx excluded from maintenance proxy.
shares_source: 980,400,000 shares post 1:10 split (CFS Note 21 / Q1 2026 report)
debt_locator: Bank loans current+noncurrent PLN 472.8m + bonds current PLN 171.9m (excludes leases) at 2025-12-31
claim_description: One diluted Dino Polska share claim on proximity-grocery owner cash, Polish store densification runway, net cash/debt, less discounter and wage-cycle reserve.

component_labels.runway: Polish store and DC densification runway
component_labels.nav: Net cash and interest-bearing debt claims

runway.label: Store densification runway per share (PLN)
runway.rationale: Bounded claim on remaining white-space openings and mid-single-digit LFL above mid-cycle owner cash (3,094 stores Q1 2026; +345 in 2025).

reserve.label: Discounter and cost-inflation reserve per share (PLN)
reserve.rationale: Negative reserve for Biedronka/Lidl pressure and wage/energy margin compression (EBITDA margin -0.3 pp FY2025).

limitations: Owner earnings uses D&A as maintenance CapEx proxy while growth store build dominates cash CapEx.
